INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFER ADDENDUM TO THE EU COMMISSION STANDARD CONTRACTUAL CLAUSES

VERSION B1.0, in force 21 March 2022

This Addendum has been issued by the Information Commissioner for Parties making Restricted Transfers. The Information Commissioner considers that it provides Appropriate Safeguards for Restricted Transfers when it is entered into as a legally binding contract.

PART 1: TABLES

Table 1: Parties

Start date: 1 April 2026.

Exporter. Full legal name: Thornbury Audiology Group Limited. Trading name (if different): Thornbury Hearing. Main address: 14 Colston Avenue, Bristol BS1 4ST, United Kingdom. Official registration number: 09884213 (England and Wales). Key Contact: Imogen Fairweather-Adeyemi, Data Protection Officer, dpo@thornburyaudiology.example. Signature: /s/ Imogen Fairweather-Adeyemi, 1 April 2026.

Importer. Full legal name: Halcyon Analytics, Inc. Trading name (if different): none. Main address: 1400 Huron Parkway, Ann Arbor, Michigan 48104, United States. Official registration number: Delaware file 7742119. Key Contact: Terrence Okonjo-Whitfield, Privacy Counsel, privacy@halcyonanalytics.example. Signature: /s/ Terrence Okonjo-Whitfield, 1 April 2026.

The Parties are the Exporter and the Importer named above. The Importer is a Processor acting on the Exporter's instructions.

Table 2: Selected SCC Modules and Clauses

The Addendum EU SCCs are the version of the Approved EU SCCs which this Addendum is appended to, detailed below, including the Appendix Information.

Date the Addendum EU SCCs were entered into: 1 April 2026.
Reference (if any): MSA-2026-0114.
Module in operation: Module Two (Controller to Processor).
Clause 7 (Docking Clause): not used.
Clause 11 (Option): not used.
Clause 9a (Prior Authorisation or General Authorisation): General Authorisation, with thirty (30) days' notice of any intended change.
Clause 9a (Time period): 30 days.
Is personal data received from the Importer combined with personal data collected by the Exporter? No.

Table 3: Appendix Information

Annex 1A (List of Parties): as set out in Table 1 above.

Annex 1B (Description of Transfer): categories of data subjects are patients of the Exporter's audiology clinics and the clinicians who treat them; categories of personal data are name, date of birth, NHS number, contact details and audiometric results; special category data is health data, transferred subject to encryption at rest and in transit and access limited to named personnel; the frequency of the transfer is continuous; the nature of the processing is hosting, storage and analysis; the purpose of the transfer is the provision of the Exporter's hearing-diagnostics platform; the period for which the personal data will be retained is the term of the Services Agreement and twenty-four (24) months after it.

Annex II (Technical and organisational measures): encryption in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256; role-based access control on a least-privilege basis; multi-factor authentication for all administrative access; quarterly access reviews; immutable audit logging; hourly incremental and nightly full backups held in a separate region with a recovery time objective of four (4) hours; annual ISO 27001 surveillance audit and an independent penetration test every twelve (12) months.

Annex III (List of Sub processors): Kestrel Cloud Services Ireland Limited (infrastructure hosting) and Sable Notification Services GmbH (transactional messaging).

Table 4: Ending this Addendum when the Approved Addendum Changes

Which Parties may end this Addendum as set out in Section 19: neither Party. The Parties have agreed that neither may end this Addendum on a revision to the Approved Addendum, and that they will instead agree a replacement within thirty (30) days of the revision taking effect.

PART 2: MANDATORY CLAUSES

Mandatory Clauses of the Approved Addendum, being the template Addendum B.1.0 issued by the Information Commissioner and laid before Parliament in accordance with s119A of the Data Protection Act 2018 on 2 February 2022, as it is revised under Section 18 of those Mandatory Clauses. The Mandatory Clauses are incorporated in full and without amendment, and no Party may amend them other than as Section 18 permits. Where this Addendum and the Mandatory Clauses conflict, the Mandatory Clauses prevail.

The Parties acknowledge that this Addendum, together with the Addendum EU SCCs identified in Table 2, provides Appropriate Safeguards for the Restricted Transfers described in Table 3 for the purposes of Article 46 of the UK GDPR.

TRANSFER RISK ASSESSMENT

The Exporter has carried out a transfer risk assessment dated 18 February 2026, taking account of the laws and practices of the United States relevant to the transfer, including section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act and Executive Order 12333, and the supplementary measures recorded in Annex II. The Exporter has concluded that the transfer meets the standard in Article 46 of the UK GDPR, and will review that conclusion annually and on becoming aware of any material change.

The Importer has confirmed that it has no reason to believe that the laws and practices applicable to it prevent it from fulfilling the Mandatory Clauses, and shall notify the Exporter promptly if that ceases to be the case.
